integrity: Self-contained proof and codebooks with dual complete integer models; new materials independently hash-checked. No independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact maxima only at even lengths two, four and six; 136 eight-base words are a lower bound, not optimality. Self reverse-complement separation and cross-separation are required; no indel correction, no asymptotic theorem. Exact six-base upper bound is reproducible complete 0-1 MILP, not a solver-independent formal proof.
title: Sharp short-block DNA-code capacities under GC balance, homopolymer exclusion, and Watson–Crick separation
